release_notes: Build 145 removes retired stock-image providers from API & Connections instead of hiding them at runtime.
The shared provider credential model is now focused on the OpenAI key used by active quiz workflows.
Deletes the temporary Pexels/Pixabay compatibility provider shim introduced during the Build 144 dead-code extraction.
Keeps YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, OpenAI quiz generation, publishing, analytics and website connections intact.
